Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

on pipe unions which Is under preparation.

rS: 3174- 1974 

2.1 Threads -- \S0 metric threads, fine series. Tolerance quality medium according to IS: 4218 
( Part V )-1 967 ' ISO metric threads: Part V Tolerances '■ 

3. Material — Steel C35MnZ5 to 15:5517-1969 'Specification for steels for hardening and 

tempering'. 

3-1 If required to be made from other materials, such as brass. It shall be subject to agreement between 
the purchaser and the manufacturer. 

4. Workmanship and Finish — Well-finished, free from cracks, burrs, etc. 

4.1 it may be surface treated for protection against corrosion. The treatment shall be at the discretion 

of the manufacturer unless otherwise specified. 

5. Designation — Shall include: 
e) Commonly used name; 

b) Pipe outside diameter; ^ 

c) Number of this standard; and 

d) Any other requirement, such as brass, if required. 

Example: 

A pipe union bolt for pipe outside diameter 10 mm and conforming to this standard 
shall' be designated as: 

Pipe Union Bolt 10 IS : 3174 

6. Sampling and Criteria for Conformity — Unless otherwise agreed to between the manufacturer 
and the supplier, the sampling and criteria for conformity with the standard shall be as laid down in 
IS : 2614-1969 ' Methods for sampling of fasteners ( first revision ) \ 

7. Marking — Shall include the manufacturer's name or trade-mark and lot or batch number. 
7.1 ISI Certification Marl^ing— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In this rovision the scope has been expanded to Include, apart from the requirements of the 
fuel Injection equipment, the requirements of the other pipe connections also. Consequently the title 
has been changed. Also, for designation, the pipe outside diameter is taken as the nominal size. 

While revising this standard, assistance has been derived from DIN 7643 ' Brazed and welded 
pipe unions with spherical liners; hollow screws ', issued by Deutscher Normenausschuss ( DNA ).
